name: bwfnx
description: Brandon Mason's Claude setup: guardrail hooks, advisory skills, scheduled-task loops, and the Maryland SBDC toolkit.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks: destructive git asks first, CRLF-churn commits are refused, session start/end protocol, protected paths, big-file read guard. Configure per project with .claude/guardrails.json.

plugins.name: advisor-skills
plugins.description: Ten advisory and workflow skills: SBIR/STTR proposal review, funding-match packet, wiki interview, teardown, build verification audit, durable learning protocol, AI analyst, transcript-to-wiki pipeline, chief of staff, email follow-ups.

plugins.name: loops
plugins.description: 23 scheduled-task templates for a daily and weekly operating rhythm (daily brief, post-meeting sweep, weekly reports, wiki audits). Placeholders for your email, CRM, and workspace.

plugins.name: sbdc-toolkit
plugins.description: Maryland SBDC advisor toolkit: 14 skills for client follow-up emails, meeting notes, SOPs, underwriting, grants, business model canvas, TAM-SAM-SOM, marketing plans, proposals, success stories, referrals, and newsletters.
